title: Add S3 and GCS sinks for customer-managed audit log export (Private)
author: Dev Patel
release_notes: Private: Add export of audit logs to customer-owned S3/GCS with encryption + short-lived auth.
description:
Implements customer-managed audit log export for Redwood Private by adding first-class S3 + GCS sinks, wiring configuration, and adding operational metrics/alerts.

Motivation
- Required for multiple Private deployments to pass security review (audit retention + customer SIEM ingestion).
- Captured via INT-883 and RFC PR #124.

What changed
- Implement S3Sink and GCSSink with shared batching/compression (JSONL + gzip)
- Add deterministic partitioning: tenant_id, cluster_id, date, part counter
- Add encryption controls: S3 (SSE-S3 + SSE-KMS) and GCS (CMEK)
- Auth: AWS IRSA -> AssumeRole with ExternalId required; GCP Workload Identity Federation
- Add buffering/backpressure for JetStream consumer
- Add metrics: last_success_timestamp, failed_put_total by reason, buffer_bytes

Review highlights
- Security: fail closed if ExternalId missing; no static keys
- Private Deployments: avoid ListBucket; ack-on-success semantics

Outcome
Merged (squash).
